text:
alex: Quick q for folks with UK Skilled Worker hires — does Redwood reimburse sponsor licence fees or other employer-side costs? trying to lock offer language.

sana: We cover employer-side legal fees and the costs the company incurs for sponsorship. we normally do NOT reimburse candidate-paid fees unless pre-approved. :thinking: 

recruiter-mike: Hiring mgr asked if we can cover priority service (~£500) for an overseas candidate to hit their start date. candidate asked about reimbursement if they pay now.

alex: Policy = company covers necessary sponsor/employer fees and we can approve priority service when it's required to meet a committed start date. candidate-paid charges should be avoided; if candidate pays we need pre-approval and a plan to reimburse. please get an estimate/quote first.

jordan: From finance side: vendor invoices preferred. do NOT route visa/vendor fees through employee expense. if we reimburse, we need a receipt and the payroll/tax treatment confirmed. cc @sana

imm-bot: Reminder: visa docs checklist updated: https://redwood.internal/people-ops/visa-checklist (includes sponsor fee flow and vendor payment steps)

sana: Proposed offer clause:
```
Company will pay any employer-side sponsorship and application fees required to secure employment eligibility. Candidate-paid immigration or dependent application fees will only be reimbursed with prior written approval from People Ops.
```
thoughts?

recruiter-mike: Sounds reasonable. One follow-up: candidate has a dependent application — manager asked if Redwood covers dependent fees in special cases.

alex: Standard: dependent fees are not covered. exceptions by exec approval only and documented.

jordan: If we do pay dependent or candidate personal fees, these are likely taxable benefits and require gross-up discussion with payroll/tax. please escalate before approving.

recruiter-mike: Candidate start target 2025-05-15, so priority service needed. I'll upload the quote and candidate's receipt if they front it.

sana: Please upload docs to the people-ops payables folder and tag @finance. note: vendor payment preferred; if candidate fronted the cost, we'll need their invoice + photo of payment + pre-approval note.

recruiter-mike: will upload today. thanks :thumbsup:

alex: Great — once we have the quote and confirm tax treatment we'll sign off and add the offer language.

sana: I'll add the approved wording to the offer template and flag for legal review.

recruiter-mike: Thanks team!
